node.statement: Scalar sharpness conclusion: if epsilon_lambda=2*lambda^2 tends to 0 and every stochastic-idempotent approximation to P_lambda has error at least lambda, then lambda=sqrt(epsilon_lambda/2), so the family has a fixed positive multiple of sqrt(epsilon_lambda) as an unavoidable error and no uniformly better exponent beta>1/2 is possible.
